errors.text_span: Втората линия е червена, с плътна линия
errors.evidence: The second line appears to be orange (not red) in the figure, as indicated by the legend and the visual appearance of the line.

The blue line also appears to be dashed/dotted with markers, which is partially correct, but the orange line is also dashed with markers per the legend (both lines use dashed style with markers). Describing only the blue line as patterned and the orange as 'плътна' (solid) is inaccurate.

The Y-axis description states values are in millions of levs (млн. лв.), but the blue line (number of contracts / Брой) is measured in count units, not in millions of levs. The description incorrectly applies a single unit to both data series. The Y-axis for 'Брой' (count) has no monetary unit.

The orange line value in 2016 is 519.4 (the lowest point), and in 2017 it is 985.8. The description says the line 'намалява до 985,8 през 2017 г.' which implies this is the minimum, but the actual minimum is 519.4 in 2016. The line decreases to 519.4 in 2016 and then rises to 985.8 in 2017.
The description does not mention the markers (circle/dot markers) present on both lines, which are visible in the figure.

The description does not mention that the Y-axis has no visible tick marks or gridlines with labeled intervals — the values are shown directly as data labels on the lines rather than on a traditional Y-axis scale.

errors.text_span: Забележимо е, че между 2020 и 2021 година стойността на договорите има видим спад от 2990,5 до 2847,2.
errors.evidence: This observation is a redundant commentary beyond the neutral technical description required. Additionally, the values 2990.5 is from 2019 and 2847.2 is from 2020, not between 2020 and 2021 as stated, making this also factually inaccurate.
